description: Find stops and stations by stop-name search, near a point or within a bounding box, by Onestop ID, or filtered to one operator's network. Returns each stop's Onestop ID, name, code, coordinates, type (platform vs. station vs. entrance), wheelchair accessibility, and timezone. The locate-a-stop step before departures — pass a returned stop Onestop ID to transitland_get_departures. For geographic queries, geocode place names to coordinates with openstreetmap_geocode first; stop-name search needs no geocoding. Provide at least one of: lat+lon, bbox, onestop_id, served_by_onestop_ids, or search.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (enrichment.cursor).

bbox.description: Bounding box "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat". Alternative to lat/lon/radius. Cannot be combined with lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center (WGS84). Requires lon. Geocode place names with openstreetmap_geocode first.

limit.description: Maximum stops to return. Values above 100 apply the 100-result page cap with a notice. Page further with the after cursor.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center (WGS84). Requires lat.

onestop_id.description: Fetch one stop directly by its Onestop ID (e.g. "s-9q8yyw3xjw-powell") or internal integer ID.

radius.description: Search radius in meters around lat/lon (max 10,000). Keep small (≤500m) in dense areas — stations multiply quickly.

search.description: Full-text search over stop names (e.g. "Powell", "Union Station"). Pair with geography to disambiguate common names.

served_by_onestop_ids.description: Restrict to stops served by these operators or routes — a comma-separated list of operator/route Onestop IDs (e.g. "o-9q9-bart"). Combine with geography to find an operator's stops in an area.

name: transitland_find_stops

cursor.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page. Present only when more results exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_filter`: No coordinates, bbox, onestop_id, served_by_onestop_ids, or search provided (server-enforced guard — the API accepts unfiltered requests but returns a global dump). `incomplete_point`: lat without lon or lon without lat. `rate_limited`: Transitland returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

stops.description: Matching stops. Departures attach to platform-level stops (location_type 0) — a station (type 1) may return no departures; use its child platforms.

code.description: Public stop code printed on signage, when published. Null otherwise.

feedOnestopId.description: Onestop ID of the source feed. Pass to transitland_find_feeds for license/fetch URL.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Null when upstream coordinates are missing.

locationTypeLabel.description: Human-readable location type: stop, station, entrance, node, or boarding area.

lon.description: Longitude (WGS84). Null when upstream coordinates are missing.

name.description: Stop/station name. Null for unnamed generic nodes (location_type 3).

onestopId.description: Stable public Onestop ID (e.g. "s-9q8yyw3xjw-powell"). Pass to transitland_get_departures.

parentOnestopId.description: Onestop ID of the parent station when this is a child platform. Null for top-level stops.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the stop (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"). Null when the feed omits it.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: transitland-mcp-server: find stops
